title: COD-AB polygon layer
description: The properties of one feature in a COD-AB polygon layer at level L. Fields named adm{N}_* repeat for every level N from L down to 0, before the other fields, in the order listed here.

^adm\\d_pcode$.description: OCHA P-code. Format: ISO3 country prefix, dot delimiter, 3-digit zero-padded integer groups (e.g., AFG, AFG.001, AFG.001.012). See P-code format.

^adm\\d_name$.description: Official romanized name. The language is declared in lang. Not null.

^adm\\d_name1$.description: Alternate-language name. The language is declared in lang1. Null if lang1 is null.

^adm\\d_name2$.description: Alternate-language name. The language is declared in lang2. Null if lang2 is null.

^adm\\d_name3$.description: Alternate-language name. The language is declared in lang3. Null if lang3 is null.

^adm\\d_type$.description: Administrative unit type as the source names it (e.g., Region, Commune). Null where the source gives none.

^adm\\d_srcid$.description: Source-assigned code (government, GADM, OSM, or other). Null where no source code exists.

version.description: Release version, identical across all rows and all levels for the same dataset release (e.g., 1).

updated.description: Date of last name / metadata change to the dataset; empty on release and populated when a minor change has been made.

valid_from.description: Date from which the dataset is valid for humanitarian use. Automatically set when a dataset is added to the global central registry. Null where the source gives no date and for area no unit covers.

valid_to.description: End of validity period. Null for the current release.

lang.description: BCP 47 language code for adm{N}_name. Must identify a romanized script.

lang1.description: BCP 47 language code for adm{N}_name1. Null if the name column is unused.

lang2.description: BCP 47 language code for adm{N}_name2. Null if the name column is unused.

lang3.description: BCP 47 language code for adm{N}_name3. Null if the name column is unused.

area_sqkm.description: Polygon area in square kilometers, computed in an equal-area projection. WGS84 area is not used.

level.description: Administrative level of the unit. A location without units at the layer's level repeats its deepest units, copying their fields down, and area no unit covers is an admin 0 unit (e.g., level 1 or 0 in the admin 2 layer).
